name: apps-greeting-after-open
description: A chat where another model opened a game a moment ago, then a bare greeting out loud. Nothing opens again, and the answer never says Yap can't open apps (a tester's chat, 31 Oct 2026: the 4B tried to open the game again, was refused, and said "I can't open your games").

expect.answer_not_matches: (?i)(can'?t|cannot|unable to|not able to) (open|launch|start)|(don'?t|do not) have access
